semiconductor_relevance: Medium — ASP Group provides cutting tools and laser systems that are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ASP Group specializes in high-precision cutting tools and laser systems, serving various industries including semiconductors. Established in 2002, the company has expanded its product offerings to include ultra-hard alloy materials and advanced cutting technologies, catering to the needs of over 1,000 users in the semiconductor sector.
capabilities: High-precision cutting tools for semiconductor applications
Laser systems for engraving and cutting
Ultra-hard alloy materials for PCB micro drill bits
